source_pattern: function returning int error code (-1 on failure, 0 on success)
transformation: Map the C error code return to a Rust Result. Use the `?` operator at the call site instead of explicit `if (rc == -1) goto cleanup;` blocks. Define an error enum that captures the failure modes documented in the C code's per-call-site comments.
